items.reason: Gap 0 describes concurrent duplicate deliveries both observing the ID as absent before it is recorded and both processing the event.
Gap 2 says deduplication uses the unsigned X-Event-Id header rather than the signed body ID and that changing it defeats deduplication.
Gap 3 states that the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, causing the refund to be lost.
No gap raises an issue that depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
